SWEET POTATO WEDGES
By: Mitko Dzhordzhev
Published: Thursday, August 3, 2017 - 5:21am

Ingredients




SWEET POTATOES
OIL
PAPRIKA POWDER

Preparation

1 Cut the sweet potatoes into quarters. 2 Place them in a baking dish. 3 Toss them with the oil and sprinkle some paprika powder. 4 Bake them for 30 min on 200C degrees. 5 Serve and enjoy the taste.

About

These potato wedges are the healthier alternative for french fries.The sweet potato is complex carbohydrate that is good for you.They are not loaded with fat like the french fries.Fat contain is about 30 grams for the whole recipe.You can add other seasonings to customize the flavor to your preferences.Serve them with your favorite sauce or dip like salsa or homemade guacamole(recipe in the blog).Enjoy and have a good time.
